title: Correction of the Translation of the Decision of the High Representative Amending the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina
text:
Emerika Bluma 1, 71000 Sarajevo
Tel. 28 35 00 Fax. 28 35 01
Department for Legal Affairs
CORRECTION OF THE TRANSLATION OF THE
DECISION OF THE HIGH REPRESENTATIVE
AMENDING THE CONSTITUTION OF THE
FEDERATION OF BOSNIA AND HERZEGOVINA
“Official Gazette of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina”, 60/02
NOTE: Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina was published in the “Official Gazette of the
Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina”, 1/94.

The High Representative's Correction of the Translation of the Decision of the
High Representative Amending the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and
Herzegovina
November 26, 2002
The text of the Decision of the High Representative Amending the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and
Herzegovina as published in the Official Gazette of Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, No. 52/02 of 28
October 2002 has been compared with the original version signed by the High Representative on 6 October
2002. Upon comparison a technical mistake in translation has been found. Therefore it is necessary to make the
following correction
CORRECTION OF THE TRANSLATION OF THE DECISION OF THE HIGH
REPRESENTATIVE AMENDING THE CONSTITUTION OF THE
FEDERATION OF BOSNIA AND HERZEGOVINA
In Amendment LXXXI, Paragraph 2, the word “uz suglasnost” shall be replaced by the word “u konsultaciji”.
26 November, 2002
_____________________
Ian Campbell
Deputy High Representative
for Legal Affairs
Sarajevo
